alisha: Quick check — finalizing the prefix-cache API contract for chat/generation endpoints. Primary Qs: cache key composition, response headers, invalidation API. TL;DR: plan below, need quick sign-off.

michael: ping me. what's the current proposed key composition?

alisha: propose key = sha256(model + model_version + route + normalized_prompt_prefix + user_visible_params). conversation_id only included when `prefix_mode=conversation`. Example headers we plan to emit: 
```
X-Redwood-Cache-Key-Hash: sha256:abcd...
X-Redwood-Cache-Source: prefix
X-Redwood-Cache-Hit: hit
Cache-Control: public, s-maxage=60, stale-while-revalidate=30
```
Note: we intentionally avoid returning the raw key/prompt.

samir: don't return raw `Cache-Key` (privacy risk). `X-Redwood-Cache-Key-Hash` (opaque) is good. Also prefer text `hit`/`miss` instead of 1/0 — easier to scan.

dana: :+1: add a `X-Redwood-Cache-Policy: prefix/v1` header so we can evolve keying without breaking clients. For invalidation we should expose a service API and admin UI button.

kevin: invalidation plan: POST /cache/purge with body `{ "scope": "prefix", "key_hash": "sha256:..." }`. Support optional `allow_wildcard=true` only for admin tokens. Purge should return job id and estimated time.

alisha: sounds right. On Cache-Control semantics: server will emit `s-maxage` for shared infra. propose `Cache-Control: public, s-maxage=60, stale-while-revalidate=30`. Document that Redwood may override client cache hints.

cache-bot: purge job queued: id=purge-20240315-77, key_hash=sha256:abcd... (initiated by dana)

michael: compatibility note — older clients that don't send `prefix_mode` should be treated as `prefix_mode=explicit_prompt`. That keeps behavior stable.

samir: tests: unit test for header shapes + e2e that does put/get within TTL and asserts `X-Redwood-Cache-Hit: hit`. Also add an integration verifying purge job actually clears the key.

alisha: I'll open a PR with the spec + docs + test stubs. @michael please review once up. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4321

michael: will review today. one quick ask: do not include `user_id` or raw PII in any key inputs. If needed, hash a per-tenant salt.

dana: for Private deployments, purge actions must create an audit log entry and surface in the Console activity feed. Add that to the contract.

kevin: SGTM. I'll implement server-side dedupe for concurrent purge requests (return existing job id).

alisha: assigning reviewer @michael, owner @alisha. Merge conditions: docs updated, tests + e2e passing, audit log in place for private. Anyone blocking?

samir: none from me. LGTM.

deploy-bot: staged contract docs deployed to staging: https://docs.staging.redwood.ai/contracts/prefix-cache-v1 (file: prefix-cache-v1.md)

alisha: thanks everyone :thumbsup: merging after CI green.
